name: Letters from Whitechapel
description: An original 1888 detective case in which murders repeat illustrations from a serialized novel before the next chapter appears.
author: Worldlines Canvas / AIRP

characters.description: Holmes’s physician, chronicler, and humane counterweight.
The frightened novelist who changed the fourth chapter’s address.
The illustrator whose ultramarine cuff and injured right wrist connect art to the crimes.
The editor who controls manuscript circulation and locks proofs in his desk.
A typesetter with blackened hands and a complete night-shift ledger.
A crime reporter who trades access for the promise of an exclusive.
